channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Sweetgreen opening first Worcester County location
item.description: The firm has not announced the store’s opening date yet.

item.title: WBJ Economic Forecast event to feature Bank of America economist
item.description: Mishra’s focus is on analyzing the labor market and GDP outlook. She regularly contributes to the “BofA on USA” card data report and has appeared on CNBC, CNN, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, and Financial Times.

item.title: Poll: Voters support rent control, income tax reduction
item.description: Pollsters found cost of living was a top concern among respondents, with 28% citing it as the most important issue facing Massachusetts. Housing was second, with 24%.

item.title: 🔒 Court rules IPG Photonics infringed on German manufacturer’s patent
item.description: The Unified Patent Court in Mannheim, Germany, identified the infringement in specific designs of IPG’s adjustable mode beam lasers.

item.title: TJX receives $470M in credit card settlement, as annual net sales exceed $60B
item.description: TJX’s fiscal year wrapped up at the end of January and saw the firm bring in net sales of $60 billion, up 7% from 2025.

item.title: Clark University climbs 14 spots on Fortune’s best MBA list
item.description: Clark was the sole Central Massachusetts university to make Fortune’s list.

item.title: 🔒 Medtronic’s R&D site in Boxborough sold for $17.8M to Boston firm
item.description: Completed in 2002, the two-story building is leased to Medtronic, an Ireland-headquartered medical device company.

item.title: 🔒 Aspen Aerogels’ net loss hit $390M in 2025
item.description: Aspen cites a drop in electric vehicle demand and production as catalysts for its major net loss of 2025.

item.title: EcoTarium expects elephant exhibit in new 6,400-sq.-ft. hall to attract 100K visitors
item.description: The hall will host “Secret World of Elephants,” a science exhibition developed by the American Museum of Natural History in New York City.

item.title: Open Sky appoints new director of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging
item.description: In his new role, Ekstrom will work to sustain Open Sky’s commitment to inclusivity, collaborating with fellow agency leaders to execute DEIB strategies throughout the organization.
